findings.note: RotoWire/CBS says Misiorowski has thrown just 13.1 innings across three playoff starts (about 4.1 IP per start). His longest was 5.0 IP in WS Game 1, still short of the 16 outs this Under needs to lose. He lines up for Game 5 in Tampa.

High pitch counts ended his first two playoff starts early (88 pitches in 4 IP, 94 pitches in 4.1 IP), with fewer whiffs and more foul balls. Manager Pat Murphy said Misiorowski is well past his usual innings limit.

Misiorowski is confirmed as the Game 5 starter at Tropicana Field after Milwaukee lost a 12-inning Game 4, so the Brewers bullpen may be worn down. That could push him deeper; he threw only 78 pitches over 5 IP in Game 1.
